column3: A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Pre-sign-up pitch slide for a house budget app named HousePlan. Top 55%: a full-bleed cinematic photo of a timber-frame house under construction at golden hour, fading into a deep spruce-green ink background (#10241F). Riding the photo's lower edge: a floating white card showing a whole-house budget breakdown as horizontal bars by category (Structure, Roof, Kitchen, Flooring) with a small "Sample" tag. Below on the dark ink: a small rounded chip with an icon, a large elegant serif headline "Plan the full house budget", two lines of light body text, page dots and a round white Next button at the bottom right, Skip at top right.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Project overview dashboard for a home-building budget app. Warm plaster background (#F4EFE7), deep spruce (#17332E) headings, teal (#2C7A69) primary button. Top: a wide rounded photo header of a modern house exterior with the project name in white serif on a dark fade. Below: a big deep-spruce summary card with "Cash still needed" as the hero number, and four small labelled figures: Estimated, Committed, Billed, Paid. Then a completeness meter bar with a marker and the line "Known subtotal - 3 unpriced lines - 2 undecided categories" with a small amber warning dot. Then a 2-column grid of quick-action tiles with coloured icon discs (Rooms, Estimate, Quotes, Costs). Custom bottom tab bar: Projects, Calculators, Advisor, Settings.

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Flooring calculator result screen for a home-building budget app. Warm plaster background (#F4EFE7), deep spruce text, teal accent (#2C7A69). Top: a minimal architectural floor-plan drawing of a 5 m by 4 m rectangular room with thin dimension lines and arrow ticks on two sides, drawn in fine spruce lines on a faint blueprint grid. Below: a results card listing Net area 20 m2, With 10% waste 22 m2, Packs 10, Material, Labour, and a bold total, each with a small source badge. A pale amber note "Tax not included". Bottom: one full-width teal button "Add to estimate".

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Estimate editor screen for a house budget app. Warm plaster background (#F4EFE7), deep spruce text, teal accent. Header with a project selector chip and a "Draft - revision 4" label. A completeness banner in pale amber: "Known subtotal, 3 lines need a price". Then a list grouped by category with category subtotals on the right (Foundation, Structure, Roof, Openings, Electrical), each category row has a coloured icon disc; one line shows a dashed "Price missing" pill under its title instead of a number. A stacked horizontal bar at the top shows category shares in muted tones. Bottom: a full-width deep spruce button "Save revision".

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Scenario comparison screen for a home-building budget app. Warm plaster background, deep spruce text, teal accent. Two side-by-side column cards at the top titled "Baseline" and "Oak floors to vinyl", each with a total figure; between them a small difference chip in teal showing a negative saving. Below: rows by category with a thin diverging bar for each difference (teal for cheaper, muted rose for more expensive), and a tradeoffs card with two bullet notes. Bottom: a teal full-width button "Adopt scenario" and a quiet text link "Keep comparing".

A single iPhone app screen mockup, flat front view, filling the frame. Subscription paywall for a home-building budget app named HousePlan. Top 35%: a warm photo of architectural drawings, a tape measure and oak flooring samples on a desk, fading into warm plaster (#F4EFE7). A serif headline "Every cost of your house, in one plan". Three compact benefit rows each with a coloured icon disc. Two plan cards side by side: Yearly (selected, with a deep spruce border and a "Best value" tag) and Monthly. A full-width teal button "Subscribe". Fine print line "Payment starts immediately; no free trial. Auto-renews, cancel in store settings." and a row of small links "Restore - Terms - Privacy".
